{{Quote|With the outcome all-but-decided, the Match Master interrupts play for some reason.|Caption to a photo from HoloNet News|<ref name="HNN" />}}
The '''Match Master''' acted as the referee in games of [[Limmie/Legends|limmie]], working alongside two assistants. This person ruled on plays, deciding when shots were offside and validating scores.<ref name="Trav" /> In [[23 BBY/Legends|13.3]], a [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]] was employed as a Match Master in the [[BlasTech Gikosphere]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The Roonan interrupted a match held as part of the [[Galactic Cup of Limmie]]'s opening round in which [[Team Fondor|representatives]] from<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|47|sports/13314_1.html|Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round}}</ref> the planet<ref name="EGtP&M">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] were competing against Coruscant's [[Team Coruscant|team]]. An article published in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District]] edition of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] questioned the Match Master's decision to interrupt play during the match at a point when the outcome was already all-but-decided.<ref name="HNN" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Parja Bralor]] served as Match Master during a game played between [[clone stormtrooper]]s and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]].<ref name="Trav" />

==Behind the scenes==
A Match Master first appeared in ''Coruscant Eliminated in Galactic Cup Opening Round'' an article<ref name="HNN" /> written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]] and illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]]<ref name="credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref> that was published in ''[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 47]]'' on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]<ref name="HNN" /> on [[March 14]], [[2002]].<ref name="HNN47 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6042498|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-03-14|time=5:40 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref>
